module_summary: 4-bit carry-lookahead adder: four 1-bit adder cells take carries from a CLA unit fed by per-bit propagate/generate, also emitting group Pm/Gm.

anchors.name: F
anchors.why: 4-bit sum assembled from the four 1-bit adder cells

anchors.name: c4
anchors.why: Carry-out produced by the CLA lookahead unit

anchors.name: Gm
anchors.why: Group generate output for chaining into a higher-level lookahead stage

anchors.name: Pm
anchors.why: Group propagate output, AND of per-bit propagate signals

anchors.name: p1
anchors.why: Per-bit propagate x^y, representative of p1..p4 feeding CLA and Pm

anchors.name: g1
anchors.why: Per-bit generate x&y, representative of g1..g4 feeding CLA and Gm

anchors.name: c1
anchors.why: Lookahead carry into bit 2 adder, representative of internal carries c1..c3

groups.name: pg_logic
groups.description: Per-bit propagate/generate and group Pm/Gm computation

groups.name: lookahead_carry
